_comment: Template: Generate SHACL shape files from RDFS CIM profile definitions.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Fill in the paths. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar rdfs2shacl --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: Use when you have CIM RDFS profile .rdf files (e.g. from the IEC or ENTSO-E) and want to generate SHACL constraints for validating instance data.
_note_rdfsFiles: List of RDFS profile .rdf files to convert. One SHACL .ttl file is produced per input profile in the output directory.
_note_outputDir: Directory where the generated .ttl shape files are written. Created if it does not exist.
_note_rdfsFormat: RDFS format version used by the profiles: '2019' or '2020' (default). CGMES 3.0 profiles use 2020.
_note_cimsNamespace: Namespace URI for the CIMS extensions (multiplicity, datatype, stereotype). Use the default unless your profiles use a custom CIMS namespace.
_note_ioPrefix: Local name of the IdentifiedObject mRID property in the profile. Default 'mRID' is correct for standard CIM/CGMES profiles.
_note_ioUri: Full URI of the IdentifiedObject mRID property. Update if working with a non-standard CIM namespace (e.g. CIM16 uses cim16 namespace).
_note_shapesBaseUri: Base URI inserted in the header of the generated shape graphs. Leave empty to omit.
_note_shapesNsPrefix: Prefix for the SHACL shapes namespace declaration (e.g. 'eqsh'). Leave empty to omit.
_note_shapesNsUri: URI for the SHACL shapes namespace (e.g. 'http://example.org/shacl/EQ#'). Leave empty to omit.
_note_closedShapes: Generate sh:closed shapes that reject unknown properties. Default false (open shapes).
_note_splitDatatypes: Write datatype constraints to a separate 'datatype-<name>.ttl' file alongside the main shapes file.
_note_exportInheritTree: Write an 'inheritance-<name>.ttl' file recording the class inheritance structure.
_note_validateShapes: After generation, run SHACL-SHACL meta-validation on the generated shapes and print conformance results.
